static_selection: highest aggregate focal wins across all three rates; ties prefer alpha 1, then alpha .5, then alpha 0
adaptive_selection: highest focal wins within each rate; ties prefer the selected static alpha, then closest alpha to it, then higher alpha
held_out_comparisons: selected per-rate mapping versus selected static
confidence: 97.5% two-sided normal intervals per comparison, Bonferroni family-wise 95% for these two secondary holdout comparisons
note: No holdout outcomes have been generated at registration; the original pilot is not used for selection.
